chunks.title: About Oikantik Basu
chunks.label: About
chunks.text: Oikantik Basu: Data Science & Gen AI Developer | Multi-Agent Systems | LLM Fine-tuning | RAG. Based in Bengaluru, India. Data Science and Gen AI developer with hands-on experience in LLM fine-tuning, RAG systems, agentic AI architectures, and production ML deployments. Proficient in building and deploying solutions using LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, and leading LLM APIs (GPT, Claude, Bedrock, Gemini). Experienced in exploratory data analysis, data visualization, vector database optimization (Chroma/FAISS), and translating model outputs into actionable business insights. Skilled in Python, SQL, and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP), with a strong foundation in statistics and machine learning. Pursuing a Master's in Data Science from the University of Pittsburgh. chunks.title: UrbanCare AI: Tagline
chunks.label: UrbanCare AI · Tagline
chunks.text: UrbanCare AI: AI-Native Clinical Ecosystem for Mechanistic Interpretability.

chunks.title: UrbanCare AI: Summary
chunks.label: UrbanCare AI · Summary
chunks.text: UrbanCare AI: A 30-agent, 8-layer clinical pipeline built on MedGemma + TxGemma + Gemini. Provides a Semantics-to-Vector interface so physicians can inspect how medical AI models reach their diagnoses — from lab report extraction and X-ray fracture detection to differential diagnosis and voice copilot.

chunks.title: UrbanCare AI: Details
chunks.label: UrbanCare AI · Details
chunks.text: UrbanCare AI: Production-ready AI-native clinical dashboard acting as a Doctor Consultant. Leverages Google HAI-DEF open-weight models (MedGemma 4B for vision/document tasks, TxGemma for therapeutic reasoning). Features a transparent Semantics-to-Vector interface bridging human-readable clinical semantics and internal model vectors — making AI reasoning auditable at every layer. Multi-tenant hospital platform with role-based access control, real-time vitals SSE streaming, and voice clinical copilot powered by RAG over patient memory vectors.

chunks.title: UrbanCare AI: Problem
chunks.label: UrbanCare AI · Problem
chunks.text: UrbanCare AI, the problem: Most clinical AI is a black box — physicians can't audit how a diagnosis was reached, so they can't trust it and compliance teams can't sign off on it.

chunks.title: UrbanCare AI: Solution
chunks.label: UrbanCare AI · Solution
chunks.text: UrbanCare AI, the solution: A Semantics-to-Vector interface that bridges human-readable clinical semantics and internal model vectors, making every layer of the 30-agent pipeline inspectable — from lab-report extraction to differential diagnosis.

chunks.title: UrbanCare AI: Lessons
chunks.label: UrbanCare AI · Lessons
chunks.text: UrbanCare AI, lessons learned: Interpretability isn't a feature you bolt on at the end — for clinical tools, it has to be the interface itself.

chunks.title: UrbanCare AI: Stack
chunks.label: UrbanCare AI · Stack
chunks.text: UrbanCare AI tech stack: React 19, Node.js, PostgreSQL, MedGemma, TxGemma, Gemini, LangChain, GCP. Primary language: TypeScript. Category: AI/ML. Topics: medical-ai, interpretability, multi-agent, healthcare. A featured project. Source code: https://github.com/Golden007-prog/UrbanCare-AI. Live demo: https://golden007-prog.github.io/UrbanCare-AI/.

chunks.title: Bruhworking — NexusFlow: Tagline
chunks.label: Bruhworking — NexusFlow · Tagline
chunks.text: Bruhworking — NexusFlow: Serverless Agent Swarm for Stateful Orchestration.

chunks.title: Bruhworking — NexusFlow: Summary
chunks.label: Bruhworking — NexusFlow · Summary
chunks.text: Bruhworking — NexusFlow: Async multi-agent orchestration engine built with Google ADK + Gemini 2.0 Flash + Cloud Run. Submit a complex task (e.g. analyze a 50-page PDF) and a coordinated swarm of specialized agents (Planner, Researcher, Writer, Reviewer) divides, conquers, and delivers — with real-time SSE streaming and per-agent cost tracking.

chunks.title: Bruhworking — NexusFlow: Details
chunks.label: Bruhworking — NexusFlow · Details
chunks.text: Bruhworking — NexusFlow: Breaks complex tasks into subtasks via BruhPlanner, delegates to specialized agents, streams real-time progress via SSE, iteratively improves output if quality score < 80, and returns polished output with per-agent token cost tracking. Deployed on Cloud Run with auto-scaling.

chunks.title: Bruhworking — NexusFlow: Problem
chunks.label: Bruhworking — NexusFlow · Problem
chunks.text: Bruhworking — NexusFlow, the problem: Long-running agentic tasks crash browsers, lose state mid-flight, and offer no mid-run visibility — so users can't trust them with real work.

chunks.title: Bruhworking — NexusFlow: Solution
chunks.label: Bruhworking — NexusFlow · Solution
chunks.text: Bruhworking — NexusFlow, the solution: A planner-coordinated swarm on Cloud Run that streams per-agent progress over SSE, with quality gates that re-run only failing branches instead of the whole pipeline.

chunks.title: Bruhworking — NexusFlow: Lessons
chunks.label: Bruhworking — NexusFlow · Lessons
chunks.text: Bruhworking — NexusFlow, lessons learned: Agent orchestration is an observability problem, not just a routing problem — stream progress early and often.

chunks.title: Bruhworking — NexusFlow: Stack
chunks.label: Bruhworking — NexusFlow · Stack
chunks.text: Bruhworking — NexusFlow tech stack: Python, FastAPI, Google ADK, Gemini 2.0 Flash, Cloud Run, Docker, SSE. Primary language: Python. Category: AI/ML. Topics: multi-agent, async, orchestration, gemini. A featured project. Source code: https://github.com/Golden007-prog/bruhworking. No live demo is listed.

chunks.title: Vyapar-Gyan: Summary
chunks.label: Vyapar-Gyan · Summary
chunks.text: Vyapar-Gyan: Omnichannel commerce for Indian retailers. Customers shop via WhatsApp or web chat in 8 Indian languages using voice notes. Gemini 2.0 transcribes voice, extracts product intents, routes to seller. Features Khata book OCR, Razorpay Route splits, and Bedrock-powered dead-stock detection.

chunks.title: Vyapar-Gyan: Details
chunks.label: Vyapar-Gyan · Details
chunks.text: Vyapar-Gyan: Full-stack serverless AWS architecture with 65+ Lambda handlers across 12 domains. Voice-first shopping in Hindi/English/Tamil/Telugu/Marathi/Bengali/Gujarati/Kannada. AWS Polly neural TTS for voice responses via WhatsApp. Proactive AI insights with severity scoring.

chunks.title: Vyapar-Gyan: Problem
chunks.label: Vyapar-Gyan · Problem
chunks.text: Vyapar-Gyan, the problem: India's next billion commerce users don't use web dashboards — they speak eight languages, live inside WhatsApp, and send voice notes, not typed SKUs.

chunks.title: Vyapar-Gyan: Solution
chunks.label: Vyapar-Gyan · Solution
chunks.text: Vyapar-Gyan, the solution: Voice-first WhatsApp commerce: Gemini transcribes and classifies voice notes, routes intents to 65+ Lambdas across 12 domains, and AWS Polly responds in the customer's dialect.

chunks.title: Vyapar-Gyan: Lessons
chunks.label: Vyapar-Gyan · Lessons
chunks.text: Vyapar-Gyan, lessons learned: Voice-first isn't a novelty — it collapses a typing funnel that was quietly blocking non-English users entirely.

chunks.title: Omni-Lab: Summary

chunks.text: Omni-Lab: Autonomous educational workspace powered by three AI agents: Teacher (Gemini 2.5 Flash Native Audio), Scientist (Gemini 3 Pro), Visualizer (Gemini 3 Flash). Upload any PDF → auto-generates slides, narrates via live voice, and lets you ask questions with real-time interruption. Generates videos via Veo.

chunks.title: Omni-Lab: Details
chunks.label: Omni-Lab · Details
chunks.text: Omni-Lab: Transforms static content into interactive, verifiable, visual lessons. Local VAD for barge-in voice interruptions. Scientist agent writes code to prove concepts rather than hallucinate. Flashcards, quizzes, infographics, and Veo-generated educational videos on demand.

chunks.title: Omni-Lab: Problem
chunks.label: Omni-Lab · Problem
chunks.text: Omni-Lab, the problem: Static educational content (PDFs, slides, lecture videos) doesn't adapt to what a specific learner is confused about right now.

chunks.title: Omni-Lab: Solution
chunks.label: Omni-Lab · Solution
chunks.text: Omni-Lab, the solution: Three specialized agents — Teacher (live voice with barge-in), Scientist (writes code to verify claims), Visualizer (Veo-generated videos) — turn any PDF into an interactive, interruptible lesson.

chunks.title: Omni-Lab: Lessons
chunks.label: Omni-Lab · Lessons
chunks.text: Omni-Lab, lessons learned: The cleanest way to stop LLMs hallucinating in education is to let a Scientist agent write code that proves or disproves its own claims.

chunks.title: Reading list: Attention Is All You Need
chunks.label: Reading · Attention Is All You Need
chunks.text: On Oikantik's reading list (paper, Foundations): "Attention Is All You Need" by Vaswani et al., 2017. His note: Transformer architecture — the starting point for every LLM I work with. https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.03762

chunks.title: Reading list: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP
chunks.label: Reading · Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP
chunks.text: On Oikantik's reading list (paper, RAG): "Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP" by Lewis et al., 2020. His note: The original RAG paper. Re-reading it while tuning my Chroma/FAISS pipelines. https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.11401

chunks.title: Reading list: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
chunks.label: Reading · ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
chunks.text: On Oikantik's reading list (paper, Agents): "ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models" by Yao et al., 2022. His note: Backbone of the multi-agent work I'm shipping at iHUB. https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.03629

chunks.title: Reading list: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
chunks.label: Reading · Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
chunks.text: On Oikantik's reading list (paper, RAG): "Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts" by Liu et al., 2023. His note: Why chunk order and re-ranking matter more than raw context length. https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.03172

chunks.title: Reading list: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
chunks.label: Reading · Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
chunks.text: On Oikantik's reading list (paper, Alignment): "Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback" by Anthropic, 2022. His note: Direct influence on the RLHF eval workflows I run at Mindrift. https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.08073

chunks.title: Reading list: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
chunks.label: Reading · Designing Data-Intensive Applications
chunks.text: On Oikantik's reading list (book, Systems): "Designing Data-Intensive Applications" by Martin Kleppmann, 2017. His note: Ground truth for building reliable backends under any LLM layer. https://dataintensive.net/

chunks.title: Working principle 01: Ship the boring version first.
chunks.label: Principle 01 · Ship the boring version first.
chunks.text: Working principle 01, in Oikantik's words: Ship the boring version first. A working end-to-end pipeline beats a half-finished clever one. Prove the wire, then tune the signal.

chunks.title: Working principle 02: Evals before vibes.
chunks.label: Principle 02 · Evals before vibes.
chunks.text: Working principle 02, in Oikantik's words: Evals before vibes. If you can’t measure it, you’re guessing. Every LLM feature gets a scored test set before it gets a UI.

chunks.title: Working principle 03: Small models, sharp prompts.
chunks.label: Principle 03 · Small models, sharp prompts.
chunks.text: Working principle 03, in Oikantik's words: Small models, sharp prompts. Most production problems don’t need a frontier model — they need a well-indexed retrieval layer and crisp instructions.

chunks.title: Working principle 04: Observability is a feature.
chunks.label: Principle 04 · Observability is a feature.
chunks.text: Working principle 04, in Oikantik's words: Observability is a feature. Traces, token counts, latency histograms, cost dashboards. The team that can see the system can fix the system.

chunks.title: Working principle 05: Data > architecture.
chunks.label: Principle 05 · Data > architecture.
chunks.text: Working principle 05, in Oikantik's words: Data > architecture. A clean, labeled, deduped dataset beats a fancy model. Spend the weekend on the CSVs, not the ConvNet.

chunks.title: Working principle 06: Write the docs you wish existed.
chunks.label: Principle 06 · Write the docs you wish existed.
chunks.text: Working principle 06, in Oikantik's words: Write the docs you wish existed. Half of engineering is unblocking the next person — usually future you. README first, commit second.
